row.scim_plan: ServiceNow AI Platform, SCIM v2 plugin (package tier not stated)
row.evidence: ServiceNow's ITSM pricing page offers Foundation, Advanced and Prime only through 'Get Custom Quote', and its docs say SCIM requires activating the SCIM v2 (com.snc.integration.scim2) plugin.
row.notes: Status kept at gated because every ServiceNow package is quote-only, not because of a documented tier gate. June's claim that SCIM/SSO needs Advanced or Prime has no first-party source and is dropped; the docs describe SCIM as a platform plugin an admin installs (or requests from ServiceNow) without naming a package. The June pricing URL (servicenow.com/pricing.html) now returns 404; the ITSM pricing page (Foundation/Advanced/Prime, Get Custom Quote) is used instead, and the 9 April 2026 consolidation date was not re-verified. SAML/OIDC SSO is the Multi-Provider SSO platform plugin, also with no tier stated. SCIM 2.0 provider supports Users, Groups and discovery endpoints with OAuth 2.0 bearer or basic auth; no SSO prerequisite. Okta's ServiceNow UD app is marked SCIM; Entra's gallery app provisions through ServiceNow's table/SOAP APIs with basic auth.

auth.token_source: OAuth 2.0 (plugin required) or Basic Authentication with a user holding the scim_admin role

endpoints.notes: Also read-only Companies, CostCenters, Departments and Locations resources.

operations.notes: Deactivate/reactivate inferred from the active attribute mapping to sys_user.active, writable via PUT/PATCH.

deprovision.data_retained: active=false sets sys_user.active (record kept); DELETE /scim/Users/{id} deletes the sys_user record. Which one an IdP sends depends on the IdP.

filtering.notes: RFC 7644 operators except NOT; maxResults 500; sort not supported.

custom.how: SCIM Extension schemas map custom attributes to fields not covered by the core or ServiceNow extension schema (scim_config_admin role); ETL definitions customise mapping

attributes.notes: The 'enterprise' list is ServiceNow's own extension schema urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:servicenow:2.0:User, not the RFC enterprise extension.

rate_limits.text: Instance inbound REST API rate-limit rules (per hour) apply if configured.

limitations.text: Bulk, sort, ETag and changePassword are not supported; POST /scim/Users does not support search or bulk modifications.
Group member arrays default to a maximum of 100 (system property com.snc.integration.scim2.max.member.count).
Requires the SCIM v2, OAuth 2.0, REST API Provider and REST API Access Policy plugins and a scim_admin user (admin-equivalent).

auth.notes: Access is governed by the calling user’s roles and table ACLs, not OAuth scopes.

capabilities.notes: Via the generic Table API on the sys_user table.

rate_limits.text: Admins can define inbound REST API rate-limit rules per hour by user, role or globally.

okta.notes: App name "ServiceNow UD". OIN page markup marks SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Sync Password, Group Push, Group Linking and Schema Discovery as checked.

entra.notes: Gallery app uses Basic Authentication and ServiceNow's table/SOAP APIs, not SCIM. ServiceNow's own docs also describe generic SCIM provisioning from a provider.

searched: ServiceNow docs search API: SCIM, SCIM plugin license subscription, Multi-Provider SSO, Table API, REST API rate limiting
open_questions: No first-party source says which ServiceNow package or subscription includes the SCIM v2 or Multi-Provider SSO plugins.
Whether IdP deprovisioning frees a fulfiller licence or ends sessions is not documented.
OAuth token lifetime for SCIM clients not documented on the pages read.
Google Workspace, OneLogin and JumpCloud catalogue apps not checked.
Audit-log API and user-event webhooks not researched beyond the Table API.
